name: Downtown Disney Earl of Sandwich "The Original 1762" Roast Beef & Cheddar or Holiday Turkey
brandOrRestaurant: Earl of Sandwich (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Baked to order on soft hearth-baked white artisan bread: "Holiday Turkey" (roasted turkey, cornbread stuffing, gravy, cranberry) or "The Original 1762" (warm roast beef & sharp cheddar, holding the horseradish sauce) are warm, soft, and budget-friendly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Original 1762" with NO horseradish sauce, the "Holiday Turkey" (light cranberry), or the Morning Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Sandwich.
watchOuts: Always ask for NO horseradish sauce on the Original 1762 and skip raw tomato/lettuce on club sandwiches
